lat: bst ras l-walida l-bare7
en: I kissed my mother's head yesterday.

lat: ma bstsh yed jddi l-yum
en: I didn't kiss my grandfather's hand today.

lat: bsti khuk s-sghir f s-sba7
en: You kissed your little brother in the morning.

lat: 3lesh ma bstish yed bbak
en: Why didn't you kiss your father's hand?

lat: nti bsti bentek l-bare7 f l-lil
en: You (f.) kissed your daughter yesterday at night.

lat: nti ma bstish khtek f l-3id
en: You (f.) didn't kiss your sister on Eid.

lat: huwa bas yed mmu b l-fer7a
en: He kissed his mother's hand with joy.

lat: huwa ma bassh sa7bu f d-dar
en: He didn't kiss his friend at home.

lat: hiya basat wldha s-sghir bzzaf
en: She kissed her little son a lot.

lat: hiya ma basatsh jddatha l-bare7
en: She didn't kiss her grandmother yesterday.

lat: besna ras l-walid dyalna
en: We kissed our father's head.

lat: ma besnash d-drari s-sghar l-yum
en: We didn't kiss the little children today.

lat: ntuma bstu yed 3mmi l-bare7
en: You (pl.) kissed my uncle's hand yesterday.

lat: 3lesh ma bstush l-walidin dyalkum
en: Why didn't you (pl.) kiss your parents?

lat: huma basu l-bebbi f l-khedd
en: They kissed the baby on the cheek.

lat: huma ma basush ras jddhum
en: They didn't kiss their grandfather's head.

lat: kanbus yed mmi kul sba7
en: I kiss my mother's hand every morning.

lat: ana ma kanbussh n-nas f z-zenqa
en: I do not kiss people in the street.

lat: nta katbus wldek kul lila
en: You (m.) kiss your son every night.

lat: nta ma katbussh yed bbak dima
ar: نتا ما كتبوسش يد بباك ديما
en: You (m.) do not always kiss your father's hand.

lat: nti katbusi khtek f r-ras
en: You (f.) kiss your sister on the head.

lat: nti ma katbusish bentek kul nhar
ar: نتي ما كتبوسيش بنتك كل نهار
en: You (f.) do not kiss your daughter every day.

lat: l-weld kaybus yed bbah dima
en: The boy always kisses his father's hand.

lat: huwa ma kaybussh jddatu kul merra
ar: هو ما كيبوسش جداتو كل مرة
en: He does not kiss his grandmother every time.

lat: l-bent katbus mmha f l-3id
en: The girl kisses her mother on Eid.

lat: hiya ma katbussh khuti f s-sba7
en: She does not kiss my brothers in the morning.

lat: 7na kanbusu ras l-walida dima
en: We always kiss our mother's head.

lat: 7na ma kanbusush yed 3mmi dima
ar: حنا ما كنبوسوش يد عمي ديما
en: We do not always kiss my uncle's hand.

lat: ntuma katbusu l-wlad s-sghar dima
en: You (pl.) always kiss the little children.

lat: ntuma ma katbusush jddkum kul yum
ar: نتوما ما كتبوسوش جدكم كل يوم
en: You (pl.) do not kiss your grandfather every day.

lat: d-drari kaybusu yed jddathum dima
en: The children always kiss their grandmother's hand.

lat: huma ma kaybusush sh-shikh f l-yed
en: They do not kiss the sheikh on the hand.

lat: ana ghadi nbus mmi daba
en: I am going to kiss my mother now.

lat: ana ma ghadish nbus khuk l-yum
ar: أنا ما غاديش نبوس خوك اليوم
en: I am not going to kiss your brother today.

lat: nta ghadi tbus yed bbak daba
ar: نتا غادي تبوس يد بباك دابا
en: You (m.) are going to kiss your father's hand now.

lat: nta ma ghadish tbus sa7bek f z-zenqa
ar: نتا ما غاديش تبوس صاحبك فالزنقة
en: You (m.) are not going to kiss your friend in the street.

lat: nti ghadi tbusi bentek s-sghira daba
ar: نتي غادي تبوسي بنتك الصغيرة دابا
en: You (f.) are going to kiss your little daughter now.

lat: nti ma ghadish tbusi khtek ghedda
ar: نتي ما غاديش تبوسي ختك غدا
en: You (f.) are not going to kiss your sister tomorrow.

lat: huwa ghadi ybus ras jddatu daba
ar: هو غادي يبوس راس جداتو دابا
en: He is going to kiss his grandmother's head now.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ybus weld 3mmu l-yum
ar: هو ما غاديش يبوس ولد عمو اليوم
en: He is not going to kiss his cousin today.

lat: hiya ghadi tbus mmha f l-m7etta
en: She is going to kiss her mother at the station.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tbus khalha ghedda
ar: هي ما غاديش تبوس خالها غدا
en: She is not going to kiss her uncle tomorrow.

lat: 7na ghadi nbusu l-bebbi s-sghir daba
ar: حنا غادي نبوسو البيبي الصغير دابا
en: We are going to kiss the little baby now.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nbusu yed l-ustad
ar: حنا ما غاديش نبوسو يد الاستاذ
en: We are not going to kiss the teacher's hand.

lat: ntuma ghadi tbusu l-walida dyalkum daba
ar: نتوما غادي تبوسو الواليدة ديالكم دابا
en: You (pl.) are going to kiss your mother now.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tbusu wlad 3mmkum l-yum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تبوسو ولاد عمكم اليوم
en: You (pl.) are not going to kiss your cousins today.

lat: huma ghadi ybusu yed jddhum ghedda
ar: هما غادي يبوسو يد جدهم غدا
en: They are going to kiss their grandfather's hand tomorrow.

lat: huma ma ghadish ybusu l-weld s-sghir daba
ar: هما ما غاديش يبوسو الولد الصغير دابا
en: They are not going to kiss the little boy now.
